extracted.name: Hamburger Noodle Casserole
extracted.description: This easy-to-make hamburger noodle casserole recipe uses a mixture of ground beef, Cheddar cheese, and egg noodles with prepared soup and sour cream.
ingredient_lines: 2 cups canned whole kernel corn, drained
1 (10.75 ounce) can cream of mushroom soup
1 (10.75 ounce) can cream of chicken soup
salt and ground black pepper to taste
instruction_lines: Preheat the oven to 325 degrees F (165 degrees C).
Cook and stir beef and onion in a large skillet over medium-high heat until beef is browned and crumbly, 5 to 7 minutes; drain and discard grease.
Stir ground beef mixture, sour cream, corn, mushroom soup, chicken soup, and egg noodles together in a large bowl; season with salt and black pepper. Transfer to a 9x13-inch baking dish.
Bake in the preheated oven until egg noodles are tender, about 45 minutes. Sprinkle Cheddar cheese over top of casserole; continue baking until cheese is melted, 10 to 15 minutes more.
